name: GeneralResearchUse
summary: The card component of General Research Use (DUO_0000042). It reads AgreementCredential, compares it with its policy data, and outputs the DownloadGrantCredential that Grant download takes.

requiredDocumentID.description: DID of the terms document the requester must accept. An AgreementCredential qualifies only if claims.agreementInfo.documentID equals it.
